market_mood: Hot inflation data and Fed officials floating a half-point rate HIKE are the dominant macro story, while AI hardware names roar back on CoreWeave's strong quarter and the Iran conflict keeps a geopolitical bid under oil and defense.
self_check: My high-confidence calls have been badly wrong (-10.6% average) while low-confidence ones did best, and oil & energy has been my worst theme lately, so today I used no 'high' ratings and avoided oil-direction bets in favor of rates, defense and deals.

picks.reason: The Iran conflict grinds on with burning tankers and threats against US officials, and a new report highlights L3Harris in a loitering-munitions market growing ~15% a year.
Fed officials are openly discussing a half-point rate hike after hot inflation, which lifts the interest income brokers earn on client cash.
Houlihan Lokey is buying Vicente & Partners amid a steady stream of M&A headlines (Sabre/Travelport, Altius/TNR, Andersen), a good backdrop for an advisory firm.
Rate-hike uncertainty means a surge in interest-rate futures volume.

Led by the CoreWeave-driven rebound in AI hardware, though higher rates are a headwind for long-duration tech.
Lagging the Nasdaq; consumer strain in the NRF retail data weighs on its old-economy names.

Rate-hike odds rising helps net interest income but hurts deal and credit sentiment; no direct news.

top_buys.pitch: Defense demand keeps building while the Iran conflict refuses to de-escalate.
top_buys.why: Tankers are still burning in the Middle East, the US Treasury chief has been moved to a military base over Iranian threats, and Iran refuses to ship out enriched material. A new industry report flags loitering munitions growing about 15% a year with L3Harris among the named players. Geopolitics has been my best-performing theme, and defense budgets respond to conflicts with a lag the market under-prices.
top_buys.risks: A sudden diplomatic breakthrough or US budget delays would deflate defense sentiment quickly.
top_buys.watch: Any Iran negotiation headlines and new DoD contract awards.

top_buys.pitch: A hawkish Fed turn is a straightforward earnings tailwind for a cash-heavy broker.
top_buys.why: Fed officials are discussing a half-point hike as inflation worsens, which raises the yield Schwab earns on client cash balances and shortens the drag from low-yielding legacy assets. Financials lagged last week, so this isn't a crowded trade. Higher rates also tend to keep trading activity elevated.
top_buys.risks: Rate hikes that trigger a market selloff would hurt asset-based fees and could resurface bond portfolio concerns.
top_buys.watch: Monthly client asset and cash sorting updates, plus further Fed commentary.

top_buys.pitch: A busy deal tape and its own bolt-on acquisition favor the mid-market advisor.
top_buys.why: Today brought a Sabre-Travelport combination report, Altius buying TNR Gold, Andersen's five acquisitions and Houlihan's own purchase of Vicente & Partners. Houlihan earns fees across M&A, restructuring and valuation, so it benefits whether deals close or break up (see the Western Union/Intermex fight). Mergers & deals has been my steadiest theme.
top_buys.risks: A hawkish Fed raising financing costs could slow deal announcements over the next quarter.
top_buys.watch: Announced deal volume and Houlihan's next quarterly results.

top_buys.pitch: Rate-hike uncertainty means a surge in interest-rate futures volume.
top_buys.why: Fed officials opening the door to a half-point hike after hot inflation sharply widens the range of outcomes traders must hedge. CME's rate complex is its biggest volume driver, and repricing episodes reliably lift activity. It's a defensive way to play the volatility without betting on direction.
top_buys.risks: If inflation data cools quickly, volumes normalize and the stock drifts.
top_buys.watch: CME monthly average daily volume reports and the next CPI print.

summary.top_pick: L3Harris, as the Iran conflict drags on and loitering-munition/defense demand keeps compounding away from the macro noise.
summary.watch: Watch bond yields and any further Fed speak on a possible hike, plus whether the AI hardware bounce holds.
